method.description: Manual inspection of unchanged native strip and composed page legend, followed by consecutive complete raw RGB blocks. Exact-white omission only in read_context.py show. Manually chosen inclusive row runs were expanded by JavaScript without inspecting pixel values, interpolation, classifier, cutoff, or centerline. All omitted columns received explicitly empty rowsets only after reading their full raw block.
method.identity_cues: Visible continuous versus broken black strokes and source legend; yellow/color strokes separately visible and excluded, not ordering alone.
method.prior_context: Shared source, protocol, AI context, earlier 14-column independent annotation and knowledge that readers disagreed. Earlier local selections were retained as prior-informed judgments and rechecked in the full raw column display; overlap is not fresh independent corroboration. Root corridor annotation not read.
limitations: Core/fringe judgments remain subjective and compression-sensitive; selected fringe islands do not calibrate uncertainty.
No attribution propagates across top or bottom strip boundaries.
No physical units, support interval, curve completion, human acceptance or historical mechanism inference.
Reader-local dash identifiers mark tentative visible fragments, not cross-reader identity keys.
